summary: Reset a USB-connected HomeBrain XIAO, request its built-in Atmosphere diagnostic, parse the structured module report, and fail on any missing bus acknowledgement or invalid reading.
inputs: one USB-connected XIAO ESP32-C6 running the production HomeBrain firmware
side_effects: Resets the selected XIAO; --flash additionally replaces its application firmware with the current production build.

environment: one explicit or uniquely detected /dev/cu.usbmodem device
